i.norm: Verifies that {@link JsonAutoDetect.Value#equals(Object)} returns {@code false} when compared against an object of an unrelated type (here a {@link JsonAutoDetect.Visibility} enum constant). The {@code equals} contract requires that objects of different classes are never considered equal.
Build a JsonAutoDetect annotation whose every visibility accessor returns null, then derive a Value from it.
A Value can never equal a Visibility: they are different classes.
